config.notes: UVic course pages are of two kinds: (1) central graduate programme pages under /graduate/programs/graduate-programs/credential-pages/ (most read pages) with Quick facts (Program options, Study options, Program delivery, Expected length), Application deadlines printed as "<Month> [entry|start] – apply by <date>" for the Canadian view and then the International view; the intakes pattern reads only the last deadline list before "Admission requirements" (the International view) when a note separates the two lists, and falls back to both lists when they run together, optional Program-specific language requirements (IELTS overall band score), and an Estimated minimum program cost that is rendered in the browser and is a whole-programme figure (not read); (2) faculty/department undergraduate and some graduate pages (index.php) that carry programme rules but usually no entry months, fee or English. No page data JSON. Fees are not read: none of the pages prints an international annual tuition figure (MEng BISY prints a per-term instalment; Elementary PDPP prints a Year 1 / Summer / Year 2 table). Central rules: English https://www.uvic.ca/graduate/admissions/language-proficiency/index.php (IELTS 6.5, no band below 6.0) and https://www.uvic.ca/undergraduate/admissions/language-requirements/index.php (IELTS 6.5, no component below 6.0); entry points https://www.uvic.ca/graduate/admissions/dates-deadlines/index.php (September, January, May); term dates https://www.uvic.ca/calendar/dates/ (Winter Session first term September, second term January; Summer Session May). Pages print month names, so no term_months mapping is set. Other entry wordings read: "<date> for <Month> entry" and "We offer entry in <Months>" / "admits students in <Months>". International view (5 Oct): the undergraduate programme pages (/undergraduate/programs/undergraduate-programs/pages/<programme>.php) draw their programme details in the browser, so page_view reads them through Firecrawl (render, no address change); the rendered page shows both fee panels ("Domestic fees" and "International fees", "rates effective May 1, 2026"), and the fee pattern reads "Tuition - International Year 1 $X" from the international panel (2 terms = one academic year; fee year from the rates-effective date). Graduate credential pages still print only an estimated whole-programme cost (not read).
